bootstrap.unreachableBody: Axentra Studio could not load the server information (GET /v1/meta). Check that the Axentra server is running and that the Studio is configured with the right API address.

incompatible.major_mismatch: This Studio speaks a different major version of the Axentra API than the server.
incompatible.minor_too_low: The server is older than this Studio requires. Update the Axentra server or use an older Studio.
incompatible.unparseable: The server reported an API version this Studio cannot interpret.

bootstrap.incompatibleHelp: Use a Studio release that matches the server's API version. See the README for the compatibility table.
bootstrap.sessionErrorTitle: Your session could not be checked

module.disabledTitle: Module not enabled on this server
module.disabledBody: The server does not report the “{{module}}” module. Enable it in the Axentra server configuration to use this section.
module.notInStudioBody: The server has the “{{module}}” module enabled, but this Studio release has no screens for it yet. Use the API or a newer Studio release.

health.title: System health
health.description: Readiness and liveness of the Axentra server and its dependencies.
health.notReady: The server reports that it is not ready to serve requests.
health.noChecks: The server did not report individual checks.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: We could not find this page
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the item was moved or deleted.
